title: Jaarcijfers voor het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden: Koloniën, 1899
publisher: Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek, Gebr. Belinfante, The Hague, 1901. Scan hosted by SEADELT.
locator: Oost-Indië, printed p. 2 (PDF p. 23), II.I.A, Java en Madoera, 31 Dec. 1896, aggregate row and notes 1–2.
rights: Numerical facts transcribed from the official printed table. Source scans remain with their archives.
note: The edition year is 1899. The population table explicitly dates its latest figures to 31 December 1896 and calls them provisional. The underlying source is the Regeerings-Almanak voor Nederlandsch-Indië for 1898.

title: Jaarcijfers voor het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden: Koloniën, 1900
publisher: Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek, Gebr. Belinfante, The Hague, 1902. Scan hosted by SEADELT.
locator: Oost-Indië, printed pp. 2–3 (PDF pp. 23–24), II.I.A–B. A is Java en Madoera, 31 Dec. 1900. B covers the Outer Possessions separately.
rights: Numerical facts transcribed from the official printed table. Source scans remain with their archives.
note: The aggregate row is a five-year colonial enumeration with incomplete returns for private estates and excludes army and navy personnel. The 1901 consolidation of five residencies changes the table's internal areas. It leaves the Java and Madura aggregate intact.

contemporary_cross_check.locator: CBS Koloniën 1904 edition (1906), printed p. 2 (PDF p. 24), III.I.A and the same 1900 row.
contemporary_cross_check.note: The later edition prints 28,746,638. Its printed component counts sum to 28,747,028, a difference of 390. The 1900 edition supplies the explicit date and a consistent aggregate row.

title: Jaarcijfers voor het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden: Koloniën, 1904
publisher: Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek, The Hague, 1906
locator: Oost-Indië, II.III and II.V, 31 December 1900 columns.
note: The age threshold separating adults and children in II.III is unverified. The indigenous sex table contains 1,390 more people than the 1900 yearbook I.A table used for the opening total. Use each publication within its own denominator.
